description:
Measure the average lamellar spacing of the eutectic microstructure in the loaded image 'AuPbSn40.tif'.

1. Set the spatial calibration: The pixel size is 0.49 µm/pixel.
2. Perform an FFT analysis to visualize the spatial frequencies.
   - Convert image to 32-bit first.
   - Generate the FFT Power Spectrum.
3. Apply a Bandpass Filter to isolate the lamellar structure (filter large structures > 40 pixels and small structures < 3 pixels).
4. Measure the lamellar spacing:
   - Draw a line perpendicular to the lamellae on the filtered or original image.
   - Plot the profile (Analyze > Plot Profile).
   - Determine the average peak-to-peak distance (spacing) in microns.

Save the following outputs:
- The FFT Power Spectrum image: ~/Fiji_Data/results/fft_analysis/fft_power_spectrum.png
- The Bandpass Filtered image: ~/Fiji_Data/results/fft_analysis/bandpass_filtered.png
- The Line Profile data (CSV): ~/Fiji_Data/results/fft_analysis/line_profile.csv
- A text report: ~/Fiji_Data/results/fft_analysis/spacing_report.txt
  (Must contain the phrase 'lamellar spacing' and the measured value in µm).
